title: SRE - brazil
description:
Decskill, founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company, places paramount importance on its greatest asset: its people. Our main mission is to deliver value through knowledge and talent, and we achieve this by fostering a culture of excellence and investing in the development and well-being of our people. With over 600 dedicated professionals and offices in Lisbon, Porto, Madrid, and Luxembourg, Decskill operates across three core areas:


  • Decskill Talent: We believe that our people are key to our success. Through Decskill Talent, we empower our team to embrace the digital transformation challenges of our clients. We collaborate with clients to drive innovation, ensuring project success and business growth.


  • Decskill Boost: Equipping our team with the latest tools and methodologies, we optimize Time-to-Market and deliver innovative solutions exceeding client expectations.


  • Decskill Connect: Our team collaborates closely with clients to implement and manage IT infrastructures that generate long-term value.


At Decskill, we believe that by nurturing and empowering our people to confront the challenges of digital transformation, we create value not only for our clients but also for our entire ecosystem, fostering a digital community dedicated to growth and progress.


We are looking for an SRE to join us on a remote project in Brasil.


Responsabilities:

  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, developers, and managers to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maximize the capabilities of our Azure platform for business applications.
  • Continuously evolve and enhance our identity management systems.
  • Prioritize the observability of our Azure environments.
  • Maintain cost efficiency and FinOps control of the platform.
  • Implement SRE and DevOps practices with a focus on Infrastructure as Code, automation, and scalability.
  • Design, develop, and implement new features to foster a CI/CD mindset, optimizing the software development lifecycle from development to production.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex incidents, ensuring they do not recur.
  • Implement code review and testing mechanisms to continuously improve quality.
  • Ensure robust security practices are integrated into all aspects of the infrastructure and identity management systems.
  • Build and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure on Azure.
  • Apply best practices for security, compliance, and operational efficiency across all systems.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Azure and its ecosystem in a production environment.
  • Familiarity with identity management technologies, particularly Azure Active Directory and EntraID.
  • Solid understanding of observability best practices, particularly in Azure environments.
  • Proficiency in using code management tools and repositories.
  • Experience with public cloud platforms.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code, particularly with Terraform.
  • Strong autonomy and critical thinking skills, with a focus on collaboration.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills (written, listening, and speaking), a collaborative mindset, and a proactive attitude.
  • Fluency in English (mandatory).


Additional/Preferable Skills

  • Proficiency in using GitLab and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Strong knowledge of observability stacks, including monitoring, logging, and tracing.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with security frameworks and best practices in cloud environments.
  • Certified Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification.


If you’re interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference DA/SRE

title: Mulesoft Solution Architect - 127594
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional Especialista para atuar com Arquitetura de Soluções Mulesoft em um projeto internacional.

Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), configurar VPNs e estabelecer conectividade segura entre ambientes locais e na nuvem.
  • Configurar Transit Gateway para simplificar a arquitetura de rede e melhorar a escalabilidade

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Inglês avançado / fluente;
  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Integração, com histórico de projetos bem-sucedidos;
  • Conhecimento profundo em arquiteturas de integração, incluindo API, SOA, ETL, Mensageria, Eventos etc;
  • Experiência com a metodologia C4E Mulesoft , preferencialmente tendo participado de sua implantação ou ao menos ter trabalhado com ela;
  • Experiência prática com tecnologias de integração, como MuleSoft, Api Manager, java sprintboot, entre outras;
  • Sólido conhecimento em design de APIs, padrões de integração e desenvolvimento de serviços;
  • Proficiência em Anypoint Studio e em componentes da plataforma MuleSoft (Design Center, Exhange, API manager, APi Governace, Runime manager, Monitoring);
  • Domínio do padrão API Led;
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas empresariais e conhecimento prático de arquiteturas de nuvem;
  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de infraestrutura na plataforma CloudHub;
  • Conhecimento sólido em redes, segurança de dados e práticas de gerenciamento de identidade na nuvem.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Consultor Comercial – Agência de Comunicação Visual

Estamos em busca de um Consultor Comercial para integrar nosso time e atuar diretamente na prospecção, relacionamento e fechamento de novos clientes. Se você é uma pessoa comunicativa, organizada e movida por resultados, esta vaga é para você.

Sobre a Agência

Somos uma agência especializada em comunicação visual digital, oferecendo serviços como identidade visual, criação de artes, encartes, branding e materiais institucionais. Nosso foco é ajudar empresas a profissionalizarem sua presença visual e fortalecerem suas marcas.

Responsabilidades
  • Prospecção ativa de novos clientes (WhatsApp, redes sociais, telefone e indicações).
  • Apresentar nossos serviços, planos e diferenciais de forma clara e consultiva.
  • Entender a necessidade do cliente e direcionar para a solução adequada.
  • Realizar follow-up até o fechamento.
  • Alimentar relatórios internos (CRM ou planilha).
  • Acompanhar o onboarding inicial do cliente.
Requisitos
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Organização e capacidade de gestão de carteira.
  • Foco em metas e alta resiliência.
  • Facilidade com WhatsApp, redes sociais e ferramentas digitais.
  • Desejável experiência prévia com vendas consultivas.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com vendas B2B.
  • Conhecimento básico em marketing, social media ou comunicação visual.
  • Habilidade em apresentações comerciais.
Modelo de Trabalho
  • Remoto ou presencial (ajuste conforme a sua realidade).
  • Horário comercial.
  • Comissionamento atrativo e possibilidade real de ganhos escaláveis.
O que Oferecemos
  • Treinamento completo de argumentação e abordagem.
  • Material comercial pronto (scripts, apresentações e catálogo oficial).
  • Suporte diário para fechamento de contratos.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento dentro da agência.

title: Analista de Service Desk (Inglês Avançado) - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. O que oferecemos a você :

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuará como Analista de Suporte no Service Desk para atendimento de clientes globais em inglês no modelo Follow The Sun (FTS).
  • Escala 12x36 (9h as 21h).


O que esperamos de você:

Indispensável:

  • Experiência prévia em Service Desk / Suporte Técnico N1.
  • Conhecimento em: Windows 10/11, contas de usuário, permissões e troubleshooting básico, Active Directory (reset de senha, desbloqueio, grupos).
  • Pacote Office / M365 (Ex: Configuração de Outlook e etc).
  • VPN, redes básicas e conectividade.
  • Hardware e periféricos.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de ticket (preferencialmente ServiceNow).
  • Inglês avançado (comunicação com equipes globais).


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com ambiente global 24x7 / FTS.
  • Conhecimento em ITIL Foundation.
  • Experiência em suporte a múltiplos clientes (MSP).

Cursando Graduação na área de TI, Graduado ou Ensino Médio Técnico (TI) completo.

title: Mobile III (PLENO)
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Salesforce Developer with Vlocity (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Responsibilities:

· Lead and own the full software development life cycle (SDLC) of Salesforce projects, including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.

· Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

· Design and implement customized solutions on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/Rest APIs, and declarative tools.

· Focus on Salesforce Vlocity development with an emphasis on Enterprise Product Catalog (EPC)/CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures (IPs).

· Manage offshore team and support existing Salesforce applications, including troubleshooting, bug fixing, and performance tuning.

· Provide technical leadership to junior developers, including planning, assigning, and reviewing their tasks, to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

· Collaborate with business stakeholders to prioritize tickets based on urgency, impact, and business value.

· Estimate effort and timelines for user stories and tasks to support effective sprint planning.

· Plan and create sprints, ensuring a balanced workload and alignment with project timelines and objectives.

· Assign tasks to team members based on skillsets, availability, and delivery priorities.

· Conduct daily stand-up meetings to track progress, gather updates, and identify and resolve blockers.

· Coordinate cross-functionally to ensure timely resolution of dependencies and issues impacting delivery.

· Liaise with the testing team to review test scenarios and support test planning activities.


Qualifications:

· Proven experience leading Salesforce projects through the full SDLC.

· Expertise in Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/REST APIs, and Salesforce declarative tools.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno
description:
Nós da Neppo , empresa do Grupo Sankhya , temos uma grande oportunidade para você, que quer atuar no mercado de TI como Desenvolvedor(a) de Chatbot Pleno , tendo como missão desenvolver e evoluir chatbots inteligentes e integrações eficientes, garantindo uma experiência conversacional de qualidade para o usuário, com foco em performance, usabilidade.


Atuando desde 2009 em Uberlândia (MG) , na Neppo somos antenados, ligados em tecnologia e em relacionamentos próximos e duradouros entre pessoas e empresas. Vivemos e respiramos criatividade e colaboração, por isso estamos sempre abertos a novos modelos de negócios e parcerias. Trabalhamos sob as premissas de liberdade, criatividade, transparência, comprometimento e inovação tecnológica.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho leve, em que nosso time tenha autonomia e flexibilidade. Nossos Neppers e parceiros são o que temos de mais valioso, por isso, estamos sempre pensando em como tornar a Neppo um lugar melhor para nosso time. Buscamos pessoas com iniciativa, sede de conhecimento, dedicação e vontade de crescer!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de bots e fluxos de integração, garantindo qualidade e desempenho.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações robustas para projetos voltados a clientes.
  • Integrar o front-end com APIs, garantindo comunicação eficiente e segura.
  • Colaborar com PO, analistas de requisitos e outros stakeholders para atender às demandas de projetos.
  • Atender chamados para manutenção/sustentação do código.
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado, seguindo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para code reviews e boas práticas de programação.
  • Documentar processos e soluções de forma clara e detalhada.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com JavaScript e Java.
  • Integrações: Experiência com APIs REST/RESTful e serviços externos.
  • Chatbots & IA: Experiência no desenvolvimento de fluxos de chatbots, prompt engineering, e tecnologias de IA/NLP (Natural Language Processing).
  • Versionamento & DevOps: Experiência com Git e práticas de CI/CD .
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (MariaDB, Oracle ). nível básico
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum, Kanban e uso de ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Trello, Azure DevOps). nível básico.
  • Arquitetura: Familiaridade com princípios de arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Seria legal se você tivesse


  • Experiência com Banco de Dados MySQL .


Localidade | Atuação


Uberlândia/MG: Híbrido

Demais localidades: Remoto

Na Neppo , prezamos muito pelo equilíbrio entre o lado profissional e pessoal. Sabemos que hoje tudo é interligado e, no fim das contas, é tudo sobre gente . Por isso, nossos benefícios são personalizados para Neppers , confira:

English fluently

Solution Architect, Azure cloud, Integration patterns REST API,

Proficiency in areas such as solution architecture, software development, databases (SQL and NoSQL), microservices, APIs, and cloud-native architectures.

Designing the architecture of complex systems, ensuring they are scalable, resilient, and optimized in terms of cost and performance.

Azure , API

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Childcare assistance

Gympass

International experience opportunity

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: JDE Functional Finance Lead
description:
We’re looking for an experienced JDE Functional Finance Lead to join our team and play a key role in supporting and optimizing JD Edwards Financial processes. This role is ideal for a hands-on finance systems professional with strong functional expertise in GL, AP, Tax, and regulatory compliance .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support JD Edwards (JDE) Financial modules , including GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, and Tax
  • Partner with Finance, Tax, Audit, and IT teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial processes
  • Translate business requirements into functional system solutions
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations, tax rules, and internal controls
  • Lead testing (UAT), enhancements, and system improvements
  • Provide functional guidance, training, and ongoing support to finance users
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate financial processes


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong functional experience with JD Edwards Financials
  • Proven expertise in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Tax
  • Solid understanding of financial regulations and compliance
  • Experience leading or supporting JDE implementations or upgrades
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and business teams
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Information Systems
  • Experience in multi-entity or multi-country financial environments
  • Prior experience as a functional lead or subject matter expert

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML)
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. About the opportunity:

Remote : Contract


The Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing) plays a crucial role in the development and deployment of innovative machine learning solutions for retail pricing that includes understanding various customer and operational business constraints and translating complex real-world problems into well-defined mathematical objectives

- Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets

- Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)

- Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure - Fluency in Python, SQL

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Consultor SAP Basis


Buscamos um Consultor SAP Basis qualificado e proativo para gerenciar, manter e otimizar sistemas SAP em um cenário RISE com SAP. Esta função exige experiência prática com ambientes SAP hospedados em nuvem, especialmente em plataformas como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Analytics Cloud e integração com hiperescaladores (AWS, Azure, GCP). O candidato ideal garantirá alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos aplicativos SAP e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com provedores SAP e de nuvem.


Responsabilidades:


  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe de Especialistas do Cliente no escritório do cliente.
  • Experiência com HANA (obrigatório)
  • Gerenciar operações técnicas para SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP BW/4HANA.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Operações de Nuvem SAP, provedores de nuvem e equipes de TI do cliente.
  • Apoiar projetos de migração para o RISE com SAP (integração, conversão de sistemas, atividades de migração para a nuvem).
  • Gerencie a administração de usuários, o gerenciamento de transporte, cópias do sistema, backups, restaurações, aplicação de patches e atualizações.
  • Configure e monitore o SAP Cloud ALM, o Solution Manager ou o Focused Run, conforme apropriado para monitoramento centrado na nuvem.
  • Implemente as melhores práticas de segurança SAP, incluindo o fortalecimento do sistema e as autorizações de usuários.
  • Analise o desempenho do sistema e proponha otimizações.
  • Participe do gerenciamento de incidentes e problemas, análise de causa raiz e monitoramento proativo.
  • Gerencie cortes técnicos para implementações ou atualizações do SAP no ambiente RISE.
  • Crie e mantenha documentação técnica, incluindo runbooks operacionais.
  • Mantenha-se atualizado com as inovações SAP (roadmap RISE, serviços SAP BTP, ofertas de hiperescala).


Requisitos:


  • Experiência como Consultor SAP Basis.
  • Experiência com HANA db. (obrigatório)
  • Inglês avançado

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
A Toronto-based agency is seeking intermediate Full-stack developers to join their global technology group. This agency lives at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity to provide clients with high-performing campaigns and digital products that shape connected customer experiences. They've helped their clients implement fully integrated CRM customer journeys, built robust digital experiences, and created national loyalty programs with decades of experience in sectors of automotive, financial, telco and retail.


Responsibilities: Designing and developing user interfaces (UIs): This involves translating design mockups into actual web pages using HTML, CSS, Component Libraries, and React with Typescript. ● Creating responsive and interactive web pages: Ensuring websites look good and function smoothly on all devices (desktops, tablets, and phones).

● Optimizing website performance: Making sure websites load quickly and efficiently.

● Writing server-side code: Using languages like Javascript, Typescript on Node.js to handle data storage, retrieval, and processing.

● Developing APIs (Application Programming Interfaces): Creating interfaces that allow different applications to communicate with each other.

● Managing databases: Designing, implementing, and maintaining databases to store and organize data.

● Testing: Writing and updating Jest unit tests and Cypress E2E tests to ensure strong test-driven development.

● Understanding the entire web development process: Having a holistic view of how the front-end and back-end work together.

● Troubleshooting and debugging issues: Being able to identify and fix problems that may arise in any part of the application.

● Working with different technologies: Being proficient in a variety of programming languages, frameworks, and tools.

● Communicating with Stakeholders: Reporting on progress to agile pod teammates, and clients.

● Creating Unit Tests: Create automated Jest unit tests and ensure appropriate test coverage


Required Skills:

Knowledge of best practices and writing Clean Code

● 3+ years of working knowledge with modern frameworks and languages (REACT & NodeJS)

● Comfortable in the command line (Mac)

● Experience with GraphQL and Apollo

● Can build a prototype and is able to take it to production (kind of mindset)

● You can demonstrate experience from at least one large scale project

● Motivation to learn and be on the forefront of current technology standards and practices

● Ability to rapidly pick up new concepts and technologies

● Familiarity with working with different CMS integrations and building out clean content structures

Responsibilities: Designing and developing user interfaces (UIs): This involves translating design mockups into actual web pages using HTML, CSS, Component Libraries, and React with Typescript. ● Creating responsive and interactive web pages: Ensuring websites look good and function smoothly on all devices (desktops, tablets, and phones).

● Optimizing website performance: Making sure websites load quickly and efficiently.

● Writing server-side code: Using languages like Javascript, Typescript on Node.js to handle data storage, retrieval, and processing.

● Developing APIs (Application Programming Interfaces): Creating interfaces that allow different applications to communicate with each other.

● Managing databases: Designing, implementing, and maintaining databases to store and organize data.

● Testing: Writing and updating Jest unit tests and Cypress E2E tests to ensure strong test-driven development.

● Understanding the entire web development process: Having a holistic view of how the front-end and back-end work together.

● Troubleshooting and debugging issues: Being able to identify and fix problems that may arise in any part of the application.

● Working with different technologies: Being proficient in a variety of programming languages, frameworks, and tools.

● Communicating with Stakeholders: Reporting on progress to agile pod teammates, and clients.

● Creating Unit Tests: Create automated Jest unit tests and ensure appropriate test coverage


Required Skills:

Knowledge of best practices and writing Clean Code

● 3+ years of working knowledge with modern frameworks and languages (REACT & NodeJS)

● Comfortable in the command line (Mac)

● Experience with GraphQL and Apollo

● Can build a prototype and is able to take it to production (kind of mindset)

● You can demonstrate experience from at least one large scale project

● Motivation to learn and be on the forefront of current technology standards and practices

● Ability to rapidly pick up new concepts and technologies

● Familiarity with working with different CMS integrations and building out clean content structures

title: Clinical Trainer LATAM
description:
About Lumenis

Lumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment. Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.


About the role:

As a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions.


Main Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director to implement and uphold rigorous high quality standards in training
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow-them up
  • Coordinate all local clinical events.
  • Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis products to the customers.
  • Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement.
  • Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.
  • Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.
  • contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience or training in the medical device industry; preferable experience in the aesthetics field - an advantage.
  • Experience in preparing and adjusting clinical presentations as per audience and allocated time.
  • Accurate in delivering training messaging.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Must be willing to travel throughout LATAM region – around 70%. and exceptionally outer LATAM
  • Interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Results- driven and self-motivated.
  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Cooperate with others, teamwork.
  • Enthusiastic about gaining new knowledge and dedicated to self-improvement by regular engagement in professional development activities (such as but not limited to gathering clinical updates from scientific journals)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese will be considered an advantage

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer with a strong experience implementing apps with the languages and frameworks created by Apple for iOS and Google for Android.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • 5+ years experience on native mobile development across both platforms: iOS and Android
  • iOS development with SwiftUI
  • Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Senior Solution Architect (Remote)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ Descrição:

Você liderará decisões arquiteturais de produtos e plataformas críticas, definindo conceitos fundamentais, elementos e relações do sistema conforme boas práticas de arquitetura. Você conectará estratégia de produto a soluções cloud‑native escaláveis, seguras e observáveis, promovendo governança técnica, redução de dívida e eficiência de custos (FinOps).


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura (microserviços/event‑driven, APIs) com ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), padrões e guias — reduzindo retrabalho e melhorando coerência entre equipes.
  • Estabelecer SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators / Service Level Objectives) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces com OpenTelemetry) para diagnóstico ágil e MTTR menor.
  • Planejar capacidade, desempenho e resiliência (caching, tolerância a falhas, back‑pressure) — melhorando disponibilidade.
  • Eleger tecnologias (Azure/AWS/GCP, bancos relacionais/noSQL, mensageria) com análise de trade‑offs e custo total de propriedade.
  • Governança técnica: promover boas práticas (DDD, testes, segurança por design), revisões arquiteturais e quality gates em CI/CD.
  • Segurança/Privacidade: aplicar OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, gestão de segredos e princípios LGPD.
  • FinOps: co‑liderar otimização de uso e rates (tagueamento, unit economics), equilibrando custo vs. performance.
  • Mentoria e influência: apoiar tech leads, alinhar com PO/PM, SRE/Operações e Segurança; comunicar riscos, dependências e impactos.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Arquiteturas distribuídas (microserviços, event‑driven) e APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Event‑driven architecture: modelar domínios e eventos, Kafka (tópicos/partições, schema registry, DLQ), RabbitMQ — aumentando resiliência e throughput.
  • Plataformas de integração: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e/ou OSB/ODI/CDC (OGG).
  • Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), Containers & Orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e IaC (Terraform/Helm).
  • Observabilidade e SLIs/SLOs; instrumentação e dashboards (ex.: Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry).
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab), qualidade (SonarQube) e segurança (SAST/DAST).
  • Bancos de dados (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis), modelagem e performance.
  • Segurança por design e LGPD.


❇️ Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Computação/Engenharia de Software/SI (ou experiência equivalente).


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio
  • Colaboração e influência sem autoridade; facilitação de decisões
  • Pensamento sistêmico e análise de trade‑offs; mentoria
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Colaboração
  • Foco no cliente
  • Visão de dono


❇️ Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Event sourcing, sagas, gRPC, estratégias blue/green/canary.
  • Práticas SRE (erro budget, post‑mortem) e FinOps avançado.
  • Certificações: Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), CKA/CKAD, TOGAF (contexto EA), DASA/DevOps, SRE.


✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada;
  • Trilha de carreira.

  • Bancos de dados (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis), modelagem e performance.
  • Segurança por design e LGPD.

  • Graduação em Computação/Engenharia de Software/SI (ou experiência equivalente).

  • Colaboração e influência sem autoridade; facilitação de decisões

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

title: Analista GIS Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga


  • Analisar, planejar e executar as atividades da área de Customer Success da Diretoria de Experiência do Cliente, com foco na satisfação e sucesso dos clientes.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Ajudar o cliente a alcançar os objetivos idealizados com a compra de nossa plataforma;
  • Gerir o Onboarding;
  • Upsell & Cross Sell;
  • Reuniões de tomada de decisão e projetos;
  • Propor as melhores soluções aos clientes, sejam mudanças ou manutenções;
  • Follow ups frequentes sobre o andamento do projeto dos clientes;
  • Avaliar indicadores de performance e resultados dos clientes;
  • Colher feedbacks sobre o produto ou serviço;
  • Elaborar e apresentar reports para que o cliente fique ciente de onde está e para onde vai;
  • Nutrir o cliente com informações sobre a plataforma de forma estratégica;
  • Gerenciar conflitos de expectativa, solucionando eventuais problemas e acionando as áreas envolvidas, incluindo à Qualidade Imagem para melhorias contínuas de nossos processos;
  • Garantir a utilização completa da plataforma de acordo com os objetivos do cliente;
  • Fazer a ponte entre os feedbacks dos clientes e operação/comercial/marketing/fornecedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado em Ciências da Terra.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Atendimento a clientes internos e externos;
  • Conceitos básicos das metodológicas de Customer Experience e Customer Success;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Vivência em projetos;
  • Conhecimento em TI (Banco de Dados e automações com Python);
  • Conhecimento sólido em ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise e aplicativos como Survey, Dashboards etc.);
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de recursos naturais ou geomarketing (ambiental, mineração, óleo e gás).


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake
description:
Title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake

Location: Remote Mexico/Brazi

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications


Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.


Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications


Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.


Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: LIDER DE OPERAÇÕES CL
description:
LIDER DE OPERAÇÕES CL


Descrição do Cargo:

Distribuir, treinar e orientar a equipe nas atividades operacionais dos setores de carregamento e transporte de peças e materiais, recebimento, expedição e gestão de estoques. Acompanhar a programação diária, avaliando a qualidade nas atividades executadas. Controlar e organizar as operações de produção de sua área, podendo intervir nas operações quando necessário no abastecimento de linha.


Função e Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar reuniões diárias com toda a equipe de trabalho, distribuindo as tarefas a serem realizadas, orientando e acompanhando o desenvolvimento na execução das tarefas, esclarecendo dúvidas quanto à execução das atividades, supervisionando os mesmos, a fim de atender as necessidades da empresa;
  • Verificar as prioridades do dia, observando os relatórios da operação e/ou produção e orientação da chefia, informando aos colaboradores dos mesmos, orientando na execução das tarefas, visando o pleno cumprimento das atividades da empresa;
  • Executar outras atividades inerentes e correlatas ao cargo.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior cursando, desejável superior completo
  • Pacote office - Excel, Powerpoint, WMS
  • CNH Categoria B Definitiva - desejável
  • Curso de Operação de Empilhadeiras - desejável
  • Disponibilidade de horário nos turnos abaixo:
  • Tarde: Segunda a sexta - 12h55 às 22h05 / Sábados alternados - 09h05 às 15h42;
  • Administrativo: Segunda a sexta – 08h00 às 17h15 - Sábados alternados.
  • Residir: em Santa Cruz Do Sul, Rio Pardo, Vera Cruz/RS.


O QUE OFERECEMOS?

Na CEVA Logistics, apoiamos e valorizamos a diversidade e não fazemos distinção de candidatos com deficiência, genêro, orientação sexual, raça/etnia ou idade. Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor, seguro, diverso e inclusivo, que incentiva a troca de conhecimentos e experiências, sempre com muito respeito às diferenças.


Com uma cultura sólida de reconhecimento e oportunidades internas, queremos que nossos colaboradores cresçam, se desenvolvam e façam parte de nossa jornada. Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios competitivos do setor. Aqui possuímos uma meta ousada de crescimento profissional interno, então, se quiser trabalhar para um dos principais operadores logística do mundo, se inscreva nas nossas posições em aberto.



SUA JORNADA

Valorizamos o seu crescimento profissional e pessoal. É por isso que compartilhamos muitas oportunidades para iniciar sua jornada na CEVA. Junte-se à nós para uma carreira desafiadora.

title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centers, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.


Title- Sr .Net SQL Developer

Location- Brazil (Remote)

Type of Hire- Full Time


Senior Developer (.NET/SQL server/AWS)

  • Good in communication and client interaction
  • 10+ years of experience in .NET technologies: .NET core MVC, C#, Entity Framework, Web API, Java Script, jQuery, Bootstrap, SSIS, Kendo, AWS
  • Knowledge on SSIS and Kendo is preferred.
  • Good working experience on DB – SQL and SQL server (Data analysis, writing complex queries, Stored procedures).
  • Good working experience in AWS cloud (like S3, RDS, Lamda, gateway, SQS) is preferred.
  • Participate in all the Scrum Ceremonies (Daily scrum, spring planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives)
  • Requirement gathering and analysis.
  • Story estimations and analysis
  • Performing UI and DB design
  • Coding and unit testing
  • UAT and production bug fixes
  • Deployment of code to Dev/STG
  • Participate in release calls and resolve the issues found.
  • Production support and resolve the issues found.
  • Performing Daily/weekly production monitoring jobs
  • Supporting the associate developers (requirement gathering, analysis, coding, testing and production support)
  • Daily Project Health monitoring.
  • Mortgage / Finance domain experience is a plus.
  • Experience in working with large applications with large volume transactions is a plus.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and unit testing activities
  • Knowledge of Agile Methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP).
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Knowledge of design patterns, refactoring, and unit testing
  • Experience with Linux and open-source software is a plus.
  • AWS Environment - EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, Containers, API Gateway experience highly preferred
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and QA activities (highly preferred)


Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

Role: AWS Developer with SFMC

Location : Brazil



Ideal Experience:

  • Initiate new, and improve existing, systems processes
  • Hands-on development and coding as needed, serving as a senior developer and technical expert.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Participate/assist in development of deployment plans for the systems developed.
  • Perform other related duties as required and assigned
  • Demonstrate behaviors which are aligned with the organization’s desired culture and values
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • At least 5+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying solutions on AWS.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure data integration pipelines between AWS services and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This includes using a variety of AWS services like AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon EventBridge, AWS AppFlow, and AWS Glue.
  • Develop processes for extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL) data between SFMC and data warehouses or data lakes hosted on AWS.
  • Work closely with marketing teams, Salesforce administrators, and other developers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Serve as a subject matter expert.
  • Specifically, experience integrating Salesforce Marketing Cloud with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, EC2) is highly desired.
  • Demonstrable experience integrating Salesforce Marketing Cloud with other systems, particularly AWS services
  • AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect certification is highly desirable. Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer or Email Specialist certification is a strong plus.

• Experience reading SOWs and presenting to executive audiences

If you enjoy being close to the technology and even closer to the customer, this role is for you.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe?   • Atuação comprovada como DevOps Engineer em ambientes Azure;
  • Domínio de Terraform para implementação de infraestrutura como código;
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD com foco em automação de deploy;

  • Vivência em ambientes Linux e desenvolvimento de scripts de automação;

  • Inglês fluente (nível C1) para comunicação diária;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, implementar e sustentar infraestrutura em Azure utilizando Terraform;
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, configuração e deploy de ambientes;
  • Atuar na evolução contínua e otimização de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Assegurar a aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, governança e controle de custos em cloud;
  • Monitorar ambientes, apoiar atividades de troubleshooting e otimizar a performance;
  • Colaborar com equipes globais, participando de reuniões e discussões técnicas em inglês.

title: Marketing Technology Lead
description:
Resumo da vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) Marketing Technology Lead com sólida experiência em Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next e Data Cloud, para atuar no desenho, implementação e execução de soluções de marketing orientadas a dados.

O(a) profissional será responsável por alinhar a tecnologia de marketing às estratégias de Account-Based Marketing (ABM) e B2C , garantindo personalização, automação e integração entre plataformas como Salesforce CRM, Data Cloud e Marketing Cloud.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Estratégia e desenho de soluções: Atuar como referência técnica em Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next e Data Cloud, desenhando soluções escaláveis para estratégias ABM e B2C.
  • Arquitetura de dados e personalização: Definir arquitetura de dados, resolução de identidade, segmentação e estratégias de personalização utilizando o Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • Automação e jornadas: Construir, gerenciar e otimizar jornadas, automações e experiências personalizadas no Marketing Cloud Next.
  • Execução de campanhas: Executar campanhas ABM e B2C em canais como e-mail, SMS e meios digitais, garantindo consistência e eficiência na comunicação.
  • Integração de sistemas: Assegurar a sincronização e integração de dados entre Salesforce CRM, Data Cloud e Marketing Cloud.
  • Análise e otimização: Monitorar performance de campanhas, analisar indicadores de engajamento e conversão, e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaboração com stakeholders: Trabalhar de forma próxima com equipes de marketing, vendas e TI para alinhar tecnologia, processos e objetivos de negócio.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em Marketing Technology: Mais de 5 anos de experiência em tecnologia de marketing, com no mínimo 3 anos de atuação prática em Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Conhecimento em Data Cloud: Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, resolução de identidade e segmentação no Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • ABM e B2C: Experiência com estratégias de Account-Based Marketing e marketing B2C.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Proficiência em SQL, AMPscript, HTML/CSS e fluxos de automação.
  • Capacidade analítica e funcional: Habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.

description:
Job description


Location: Remote

Engagement: Part-time (20 hours per week, ongoing collaboration)

Seniority: Mid-level

Language required: Advanced English

Rate: 1.200 USD


The Role


We’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to support the continuous evolution of a SaaS product, with a strong preference for candidates who have worked on fintech or financial SaaS platforms .

This is a part-time (20h/week), ongoing role , ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with product and engineering teams, translating complex requirements into clear, user-centered design solutions. As a startup, we value flexibility, autonomy, and a hands-on mindset.


Responsibilities


  • Design user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI for web-based SaaS products.
  • Improve usability and visual consistency across the platform.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to shape features from concept to delivery.
  • Apply UX thinking to simplify complex, data-heavy or financial interfaces.
  • Maintain and evolve design systems and UI components.
  • Incorporate feedback and iterate quickly in a fast-moving environment.
  • Support marketing initiatives when needed, including visual assets and design for marketing content.


What We’re Looking For


  • Proven experience as a UI/UX Designer working on SaaS products .
  • Strong preference for experience in fintech, finance, or data-heavy platforms .
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, usability, and interaction design.
  • Strong visual design skills with high attention to detail.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (required).
  • Ability to communicate design decisions clearly in English .
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in a part-time setup .


Nice to Have


  • Graphic design skills , especially to support marketing content and visual assets.
  • Experience working with early-stage or fast-growing startups.
  • Familiarity with design systems and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience collaborating in remote, distributed teams.

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;
